name: Plate V: The Tree of Life
description: The ten Sephiroth and twenty-two paths of the Otz Chiim, struck through by the Lightning Flash that descends from Kether to Malkuth. Struck in Folio: iron-gall ink on rag paper, as the old plates were printed. “ΓΝΩΘΙ ΣΕΑΥΤΟΝ”: Know thyself (the Delphic maxim).
